classification.resume: This is a television news report from the Swiss Tagesschau broadcast on 5 August 1980, documenting the 35th anniversary commemorations of the Hiroshima atomic bombing. It shows a peace ceremony in Hiroshima's Peace Park, including a speech by Mayor Takeshi Araki, a wreath-laying at the Cenotaph, and the ringing of the Peace Bell. British anti-nuclear activist Philip Noel-Baker is also shown seated with other opponents of the atomic bomb.
